Content read: sec. 4 design pressure/temperature (Table 1 margin - high trip 0-35 barg at least 3.5 bar below PSV set; above 35 barg 10% of set pressure), sec. 5 safety-instrumented secondary pressure protection, sec. 6 line sizing (gravity drains 1:100, 1:50 with sand; sewage/open drain header DN 100, sub-headers DN 80; flare lines rho-V below 200,000 kg/ms and flare headers Mach 0.6), sec. 7 system/equipment requirements incl. flare, vent and closed-drain connections.
